concepts.name: mat
concepts.definition: A numbered mat at an event. It runs matches in its order, and at most one bound tablet scores it at a time.

concepts.name: team
concepts.definition: A gym's side at an event, with a colour and a position. Its kids earn the team points the leaderboard ranks.

concepts.name: roster
concepts.definition: The kids of one event, copied from a paste, a WellnessLiving sync or a hand entry, never a live reference.

concepts.name: pair
concepts.definition: Two kids from different teams set to meet in one match, proposed by the matchmaker or designed by the organizer.

concepts.name: snapshot
concepts.definition: The one view of an event that every board, tablet and console polls, keyed by the event version.

concepts.name: board
concepts.definition: The television view of an event: the team leaderboard, the mats and the results, read with no token.

concepts.name: win type
concepts.definition: How a match was won: submission, points, decision, walkover or dq. It sets the team points the win earns.

concepts.name: feed
concepts.definition: A link from an empty bracket side to the winner or the loser of another match, filled when that match ends.

concepts.name: division
concepts.definition: A named set of kids across teams with one format and one styles setting, generated into matches once per style.

concepts.name: belt
concepts.definition: A kid's jiu jitsu rank, read from WellnessLiving or a paste, that the pair cost weighs at a half per step.

concepts.name: clock
concepts.definition: A match's running time, kept as elapsed time plus a start instant and expired lazily when a screen reads it.
